NTA CSIR UGC NET June Score Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : National Testing Agency (NTA-CSIR UGC NET) has released the score card for the CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Examination on the official website of the NTA in this week. The online application process for NTA CSIR UGC NET June online Form 2026 were accepted from 27 May 2026 to 19 June 2026. The Exam was conducted on 17,18 July 2026. Candidates who appeared in this examination can download their NTA CSIR UGC NET June Score Card 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 May 2026
  • Last Date : 19 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 22-23 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 17, 18 July 2026
  • Exam City Intimation : 08 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 13 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 29 August 2026
  • Result : 29 August 2026
  • Score Card : 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC NCL : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 325/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
